scope.description: Control for the empty-change-set panic finding: run the same joint configuration with an empty ConfChangeV2 that carries the documented Auto transition, and record that it leaves the joint configuration without panicking, next to the explicit-transition case that panics.
assumptions: Real raft over voters {1,2,3} built with newTestRaft and library defaults; the joint configuration is entered the same way in both cases (ConfChangeV2 with an explicit transition and one add-node change).
The control change is the zero-valued ConfChangeV2, which is the documented idiom for leaving a joint configuration.
ApplyConfChange is invoked directly in both cases because a quorum-less instance cannot commit; the panic is captured with recover so it is recorded as data, and no production logic is modified.
excluded: Any claim about client-side construction of change messages; only the two library forms are compared.
Cases where the configuration is not joint, which existing validation already rejects with a log message.

basis.prefix: TestAssuranceEmptyAutoConfChangeLeavesJoint builds newTestRaft(1,3,1,newTestMemoryStorage(withPeers(1,2,3))), promotes it, applies the same explicit-transition EnterJoint change as the other test, and emits a setup event with the configuration, the control change's transition, change count, LeaveJoint and EnterJoint results. It then applies the zero-valued ConfChangeV2 inside a recover and emits whether it panicked, the panic text, whether the configuration is still joint afterwards and the resulting voters. The other test in the same harness keeps the explicit-transition case, so one invocation records both the defect and its control.

comparisons.description: Control: the Auto-transition empty change does not panic, so the failure is specific to the explicit transition rather than to empty change sets.
Control: the Auto-transition empty change leaves the joint configuration as documented, showing the apply path works when the two leave-joint tests agree.

knowledge.assertion: validation derives leave-joint from len(Changes) == 0 while the apply path derives it from LeaveJoint, which also requires the Auto transition
